title: Resolved wiring
description: Wiring of one project, resolved from its Markdown wiring document by the wiring skills. Committed next to the document; the CLI builds and renders the Circuit Studio project from this file alone, without an LLM. First version: fields are added as the next phases need them.

source.description: The Markdown document this file was resolved from. The CLI recomputes the hash and reports a stale file when the document changed since.

path.description: Path of the Markdown document, relative to this file.

connections.description: In the order in which the video connects the wires.

layout.description: Optional placement hints, top view, in millimetres from the origin; rotation in degrees around the vertical axis. Parts not listed are placed automatically.

line.description: Line of the Markdown document this entry comes from (1-based), for messages.

name.description: Name used in the document, unique in the project.

kind.description: catalog: built-in Circuit Studio model (modelId). prepared: part produced by wiring-parts (ref). stand-in: plain box with the listed pins, until a model exists.

modelId.description: Circuit Studio built-in model, for kind catalog.

ref.description: Prepared part identifier, for kind prepared.

model.description: Source model file (STEP, GLB) in the user's project, if any.

size.description: Box size in mm (width, height, thickness), for kind stand-in.

pins.description: Pin identifiers of a stand-in, in order.

pin.description: Pin identifier in the part definition (not a label or an alias).

text.description: The reference as written in the document.

color.description: Wire colour: a name (black, red, orange, blue, purple, green, brown, yellow, white) or #rrggbb.

to.description: One or more destinations; several destinations give one wire each, from the same source.
